# Existing Methods

## Regression

```{r hurricane-regression-fit}
reg_hurr <- calc_regression(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "expected_deaths_diff")
attr(reg_hurr, "tidy")
```

```{r hurricane-regression-summary}

```


```{r hurricane-regression-model-check}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12
# All-in-one model checks
```

Posterior predictive check comparing simulated data from the model to actual observed data. Uses R's `simulate()` function on the lm.

## FANOVA

```{r hurricane-fanova-fit}
fanova_hurr <- calc_fanova(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "expected_deaths_diff")
fanova_hurr
```

```{r hurricane-fanova-importance-plot}
fanova_hurr |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

Only main effects

```{r hurricane-fanova-main-effects-plot}
fanova_hurr |>
  filter(is.na(level_1)) |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```


# Our Framework

```{r hurricane-decide}
decide_hurr <- decide(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "expected_deaths_diff")
decide_hurr
```

```{r hurricane-decide-plot}
# NA leads to problem
decide_vec(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "expected_deaths_diff") |>
  vis_importance()
```

## Combine

```{r hurricane-combine-importance}
vis_importance_2dim(
  decide_vec(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "expected_deaths_diff"),
  fanova_hurr |> fanova_to_vec()
)
```

## Composite importance table

```{r hurricane-importance-composite}
compose_importance_table(
  decide = decide_hurr,
  fanova_main = calc_fanova_main_importance(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "expected_deaths_diff"),
  fanova_total = fanova_hurr |> fanova_total_to_vec(),
  regression = regimp_hurr,
  caption = "Importance estimates per decision, by method (Hurricane).",
  label = "importance-hurricane"
)
```

# Ablation Study

Fix each decision to one option, recompute the importance estimates on the
reduced multiverse, and compare the resulting importance vectors across
methods and across options of the fixed decision.

```{r hurricane-ablation-run}
ablation_hurr <- run_ablation_analysis(
  mv_hurr,
  colname_metric = "expected_deaths_diff"
)
```

## Inter-method stability

The table below shows the baseline agreement between methods on the full
multiverse, plus the average agreement after fixing each decision and averaging
over that decision's options.

```{r hurricane-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_hurr$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r hurricane-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 3.2
#| fig-height: 4
# same row order in the inter- and intra-method heatmaps
decision_order_hurr <- stability_decision_order(ablation_hurr$intra_method_stability_summary)
p <- vis_inter_method_stability(
  ablation_hurr$inter_method_stability_summary,
  decision_order = decision_order_hurr,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact()
p
ggsave(here("figures", "hurricane-ablation-inter-method.pdf"), p, width = 3.2, height = 4, create.dir = TRUE)
```

## Intra-method stability

For each method separately, compare its full-multiverse importance vector to
the importance vector obtained after fixing one decision to one option, then
average those correlations over the options of the fixed decision.

```{r hurricane-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_hurr$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r hurricane-ablation-intra-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 3.2
#| fig-height: 4
p <- vis_intra_method_stability(
  ablation_hurr$intra_method_stability_summary,
  decision_order = decision_order_hurr,
  value_size = 1.6
) + theme_stability_compact()
p
ggsave(here("figures", "hurricane-ablation-intra-method.pdf"), p, width = 3.2, height = 4, create.dir = TRUE)
```
